outcomes.text: Analyse the causes and consequences of historical events.
Analyse what continued and what changed over time.
Compare how different people and sources see the same events.
Judge the significance of events, people and developments.
Understand sources, analyse how their context shapes their use, and synthesise their perspectives.
Analyse and evaluate historical arguments and formulate an inquiry question.

topics.title: Focused study options (choose one option, two focused studies)

outcomes.text: Study the two focused studies of the option 'Independence and identity' using sources and inquiry questions.
Study the two focused studies of the option 'Political and economic transitions' using sources and inquiry questions.
Study the two focused studies of the option 'Conflict and displacement' using sources and inquiry questions.
Study the two focused studies of the option 'Climate and innovation' using sources and inquiry questions.
Study the two focused studies of the option 'Protest and change' using sources and inquiry questions.
Study conflict across history from 750 CE through examples from several regions.
Study innovation and transformation across history from 750 CE.
Study authoritarian rule from 1750 CE through examples from several regions.
Study popular movements from 1750 CE through examples from several regions.

topics.title: Regional study options (choose one region, two studies)

outcomes.text: Study two studies from the region 'Africa and the Middle East' and evaluate historical perspectives on them (higher level).
Study two studies from the region 'The Americas' and evaluate historical perspectives on them (higher level).
Study two studies from the region 'Asia and Oceania' and evaluate historical perspectives on them (higher level).
Study two studies from the region 'Europe' and evaluate historical perspectives on them (higher level).
Formulate an inquiry question and choose sources for a historical topic of your choice.
Analyse the chosen sources and synthesise the evidence into a response.
